package sandboxclient

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) CreateOrResumeSandbox(ctx context.Context, request domain.SandboxProvisionRequest) (*domain.SandboxSession, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox service url is empty")
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"user_id":                  request.StudentID,
		"task_id":                  request.TaskID,
		"answer_id":                request.AnswerID,
		"compose_config":           json.RawMessage(request.ComposeConfig),
		"code_structure_type_code": request.CodeStructureTypeCode,
		"code_structure":           json.RawMessage(request.CodeStructure),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/api/v1/sandboxes", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.setInternalAuthentication(httpRequest)

	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox create request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}

	var payload struct {
		SandboxID       string `json:"sandboxId"`
		PreviewURL      string `json:"previewUrl"`
		SandboxIDSnake  string `json:"sandbox_id"`
		PreviewURLSnake string `json:"preview_url"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sandboxID := firstNonEmpty(payload.SandboxID, payload.SandboxIDSnake)
	if sandboxID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox response missing sandbox id")
	}
	return &domain.SandboxSession{
		SandboxID:  sandboxID,
		PreviewURL: firstNonEmpty(payload.PreviewURL, payload.PreviewURLSnake),
	}, nil
}

func (client Client) CreateFile(ctx context.Context, sandboxID, _ string, path, content string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("sandbox service url is empty")
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"path":    path,
		"content": content,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, fmt.Sprintf("%s/api/v1/sandboxes/%s/files", strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/"), sandboxID), bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.setInternalAuthentication(httpRequest)

	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return fmt.Errorf("sandbox create file request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	return nil
}

func (client Client) GetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) ([]domain.WorkspaceFile, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox service url is empty")
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/sandboxes/%s/snapshot", strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/"), sandboxID), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if client.InternalToken != "" {
		httpRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	}

	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox snapshot request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}

	var payload struct {
		Files []struct {
			Path    string `json:"path"`
			Content string `json:"content"`
		} `json:"files"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	files := make([]domain.WorkspaceFile, 0, len(payload.Files))
	for _, file := range payload.Files {
		files = append(files, domain.WorkspaceFile{
			Path:    file.Path,
			Content: file.Content,
		})
	}
	return files, nil
}

func (client Client) GetValidationObservation(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) (domain.LearningActionValidationObservation, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(sandboxID) == "" {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, fmt.Errorf("sandbox validation observation configuration is invalid")
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/sandboxes/%s/validation-observation", strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/"), url.PathEscape(sandboxID)), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, err
	}
	if client.InternalToken != "" {
		httpRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	}
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, fmt.Errorf("sandbox validation observation request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: 64<<10 + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var result domain.LearningActionValidationObservation
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid sandbox validation observation response")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) FindSandbox(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID string) (*domain.SandboxSession, error) {
	return client.findSandbox(ctx, userID, taskID, "")
}

// FindSandboxForAnswer resolves the exact Sandbox bound to the answer behind a
// Student-owned learning action. The answer identity never leaves Student's
// internal boundary.
func (client Client) FindSandboxForAnswer(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string) (*domain.SandboxSession, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(answerID) == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return client.findSandbox(ctx, userID, taskID, answerID)
}

func (client Client) findSandbox(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string) (*domain.SandboxSession, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox service url is empty")
	}
	values := url.Values{}
	values.Set("user_id", userID)
	values.Set("task_id", taskID)
	if strings.TrimSpace(answerID) != "" {
		values.Set("answer_id", answerID)
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/sandboxes?"+values.Encode(), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if client.InternalToken != "" {
		httpRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	}
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox find request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	var payload struct {
		SandboxID string `json:"sandboxId"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if payload.SandboxID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &domain.SandboxSession{SandboxID: payload.SandboxID}, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 20 * time.Second}
}

func (client Client) setInternalAuthentication(request *http.Request) {
	if token := strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken); token != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	}
}

func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
	for _, value := range values {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
			return value
		}
	}
	return ""
}
